construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation created for this isolated build.

shared_schema.input: Exact fields: schema_version=1, message (nonblank, <=4000 characters), filters {category: string|null, max_price: finite nonnegative number|null, limit: integer 1..20}, knowledge [{id,question,answer,keywords:string[]}], products [{id,name,description,category,price,in_stock:boolean,tags:string[]}]. All textual record fields are nonblank. IDs are unique within each collection. Prices use a single caller-selected currency.
shared_schema.validation: Shared validate function validates input, grounded support contract, preserved handoff and search result shape. CLI rejects unknown fields, duplicate JSON object keys, malformed JSON and nonfinite numbers.

cross_stage_handoffs.payload: Validated support.search_request contains the exact original query and a copied, validated filter object.
cross_stage_handoffs.enforcement: Search revalidates support output against input before consuming its search_request. Tampered queries, filters, citations or answer grounding are rejected.

behavior.support: Match normalized explicit knowledge keywords, select at most two topics by overlap then ID, quote supplied answers with citation IDs. Unsupported questions receive a fixed uncertainty response and needs_human=true without blocking search. No ticket is sent or created.
behavior.search: Unicode word tokenization, case folding, stopword removal and bounded synonym normalization. Weighted overlap favors names/tags over descriptions/categories. Stock, category, price and limit are hard filters. Stable ordering is score descending, price ascending, ID ascending. Unrelated catalog items are not returned.
behavior.injection: Optional run(data, responder=callable) receives an isolated support proposal. Shared validation permits only exact cited knowledge or the fixed fallback and prohibits changed search intent. Tests use offline identity, malformed and fabricated-answer fixtures.
behavior.fixtures: All example policy and product records are clearly labeled synthetic.

test_outcomes.cli_example: Passed: one JSON object, status ok, grounded return policy and two matching in-stock products within the price cap.
